prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Interactive Activity Stream: Displays real-time animated status updates and cycling companion tips during desktop render waiting time.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15}}
1: [finish, redesign] Desktop Companion Orientation Welcome Screen: Redesigns the home_intro screen into a spotlight view highlighting pet controls, tray shortcuts, and desktop interaction toggles.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Learn how to interact, minimize, and chat with your desktop pet before starting.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Click pet to chat | Drag to move | Right-click to hide", "style": "highlight"}]}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Custom Pet Crafting Interactive Studio: Rebuilds the pick_friend screen using a stage layout featuring live animated pet previews and custom trait options.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Craft Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Select traits and preview your companion in real time before finalizing adoption.", "components": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:pet_preview_stage", "style": "playful"}]}}
3: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Sync Reminder Hint: Adds an explicit sync reminder hint on the sign-in screen informing users how existing pets are restored upon authentication.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing into your existing account automatically restores all previously created pets and companion settings."}}
4: [choose_path, new_screen] Pet Archetype Orientation Screen: Inserts an archetype overview screen prior to path selection to explain the difference between instant adoption and custom photo generation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_archetype_intro", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_archetype_intro": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Choose How You Want to Meet Your Pet", "body": "Pick a ready-to-play standard companion or create a custom pet from your photos."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Progress Notification Banner: Updates the waiting screen to show step-by-step rendering progress notifications and setup completion readiness cues.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "show_progress": true, "hint": "Preparing desktop environment and placing your companion on screen..."}}
6: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Control Master Class Flow: Adds a secondary controls walkthrough step after home_intro demonstrating shortcut keys, system tray hiding, and audio controls.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_controls_walkthrough"], "new_controls_walkthrough": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Desktop Pet Controls Walkthrough", "body": "Learn how to trigger actions, hide the pet to your system tray, and adjust companion audio settings."}}
7: [sign_in, redesign] Account Recovery and Authentication Hub Redesign: Redesigns sign_in into a split layout clearly separating new account creation from existing pet account recovery.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe", "body": "Log in with your existing account to restore previous pets, or create a new account to sync across devices."}}
8: [choose_path, layout] Dual Column Path Choice Grid: Reformats choose_path into a two_column layout contrasting pet selection options, render expectations, and customization choices.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Select Your Adoption Journey", "body": "Compare pre-built instant companions vs. custom AI-generated pets side by side."}}
9: [adoption, incentive] Pet Personality Customization Boost: Adds a unlocked trait badge and companion personality badge to the adoption certificate screen to confirm pet readiness.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Personality Unlocked: Energetic Explorer", "style": "playful"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Adding progress and time estimate to the waiting screen during a real wait is allowed.
Redesigning the home intro screen while maintaining onboarding limits is permitted.
Redesigning pick_friend to craft/choose a pet preserves the screen's core job.
Adding an informative hint to the sign-in screen is allowed.
Inserting a new onboarding screen before path selection is permitted.
Adding progress and completion notifications to the waiting screen is allowed.
Adding new screens after home_intro inside onboarding is allowed.
Redesigning the sign-in screen layout preserves its functionality.
Reformatting choose_path still offers both adopting pre-built pets and creating custom pets.
Replacing components on the adoption certificate removes the required official stamp.
